description: Finch is a Web Processing Service from the Birdhouse community for computing climate indicators. It exposes climate-analysis processes over a service interface and documents package installation and developer workflows. Users submit climate datasets, an area or station selection and indicator parameters; outputs are derived climate metrics for the chosen period. Geographic coverage depends on the input dataset and the deployed service. Apache-2.0 source, PyPI information and a public documentation site are available. A limitation is that an indicator inherits biases and missing values from its climate inputs, and a hosted service may impose its own capacity and access settings. Finch can compute heat or precipitation indicators used to stress-test buildings, roads and drainage systems. The related catalogue ERA5 record is an upstream reanalysis source, not a computed Finch indicator. No climate dataset or package was downloaded.
